Jamal: Quick heads-up — Acme QBR deck needs owners and final asks. Meeting Tue 10am PT. Can folks take slides and ack by EOD Fri? Link to folder: https://drive.redwood/acme/qbr 
Elaine (CSM): I'll own onboarding health + adoption metrics slide. Need help with the usage chart data. @Sarah can you share the weekly cohort export? :thumbsup:
Mike (Solutions): I'll take technical architecture + demo notes. Can someone add a screenshot of the latest integration flow (prod) to the assets folder?
Sarah (EngOps): I can drop the SLA and latency metrics. Will upload metrics csv and the query I'm using. SQL snippet: ```sql
SELECT week, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms FROM inference_metrics WHERE account_id = 'acme' ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12;
```
Alex (Director): For exec readout, call out renewal risk: two stalled seats and a billing question. Jamal, can you add a 1-slide risk summary and proposed mitigation? Keep it <1min.
Jamal: noted — I'll draft the risk slide and proposed next steps (health play + finance sync). Goal: 3 asks max for execs.
QBR-Bot: Reminder set for 2024-11-05 17:00 UTC — prepare slides and upload by 2024-11-08 23:59 UTC. 
Elaine (CSM): Uploading onboarding heatmap now (assets/onboarding-heatmap.png). Also flag: one customer success playbook item pending legal sign-off.
Mike (Solutions): Screenshot uploaded to assets/integration-flow.png. Also adding a short demo script: 3 bullet steps + fallback plan if model latency spikes.
Sarah (EngOps): Metrics CSV uploaded: assets/acme_metrics_weekly.csv and query pasted in the doc under "metrics-source". If anyone wants raw logs DM me.
Jamal: Deadline reminder — please confirm slide ownership in thread: onboarding (Elaine), metrics (Sarah), tech/demo (Mike), exec risk (Jamal). Any objections?
Elaine (CSM): Ack — will finish slide and notes by EOD Fri.
Mike (Solutions): Ack, will rehearse demo Friday afternoon. Need someone to validate access to their sandbox account for demo — @Elaine can you share creds?
Elaine (CSM): Will send temporary view-only creds to Mike via 1:1.
Alex (Director): Good — once slides are in, I'll do a quick exec polish pass Mon morning. Please tag me when done. :spiral_calendar:
Jamal: Thanks team — if no further blockers, I'll collate and export the deck Mon noon and post final link here. :thumbsup:
